name: karpathy-graph
description: Build typed, provenance-tracked knowledge graphs from any context — documents, codebases, incidents, research — so one or many AI agents share durable memory instead of copying transcripts. Use when the user says "build a knowledge graph", "criar grafo", "map this codebase/domain", "graph these documents", "extract entities and relations", "ground this claim", "visualize the graph", or asks how facts, sources and experiments connect. Implements the graph plane from Karpathy's Graph Engineering Systems: extract, resolve, assemble, query, evaluate. Every claim carries a source, every merge is reversible, every answer cites edge ids. Writes to the given path, or to ./.karpathy-graphs/<graph-name>/ by default, and renders an interactive HTML explorer for humans.
